text_block_list.text:
One day, I was helping run a fan event for 
the academy students. While managing the line for 
one of the main attractions, a handshake event—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, my lovely principessa. 
Not a single day went by that I forgot that smile... 
To see you again is like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Earth's fan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, Earth-sama remembered who I am...! 
Please let me record that right nooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please keep giving me lots of support! 
If you do... I'll be able to work even harder♪

text_block_list.name: Royce's fans
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! I'll be at every single race! 
I'm gonna support Royce-chan!!
choice_data_list: (Whoa, both of them are insanely popular...!)
(Wow, both of them are insanely popular...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, benissimo! 
Everyone was thrilled to bits!!
choice_data_list: （おお、2人ともすごい人気だな……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Whoa, both of them are insanely popular...!)
(Wow, both of them are insanely popular...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'Fan Service God' 'Royce-tan is the best'—— 
The social media buzz is going great too. 
Heh heh heh, the morning session was a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this afternoon I shall shower you with words of love. 
Even more passionately, and even more fortissimo!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that really is your stance. 
Then I'll continue on with Operation 
'Fan-Favorite Royce-chan' as planned.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that your rhythm? 
If it were me, I wouldn't be able to resist whispering sweet nothings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you really are that type, aren't you? 
Earth's fans love that about you, too. 
Isn't that a wonderful win-win relationship?

Their approaches may differ, but both have gained 
tremendous popularity with the fans. Which meansâ
choice_data_list: If you learn from each other, you'll probably become even more popular.
If you learn from each other, you'll probably get even more popular.

text_block_list.name: Earth & Lois
choice_data_list: 吸収しあえば、さらに人気が出そうだ
吸収しあえば、さらに人気が出そうだね
choice_data_list_en: If you learn from each other, you'll probably become even more popular.
If you learn from each other, you'll probably get even more popular.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Both methods are great for gaining fans. 
If only we could combine them into one...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Love will delve even deeper!
It's bound to become even more dolce!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Royce-san. May I borrow 
your beautiful expression of love?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I was thinking the exact same thing. 
I'll be paying a visit to your field, then.

The afternoon meet-and-greet is packed to capacity, too. 
With Sounds of Earth making her entrance, 
the fans' excitement is boiling over!

text_block_list.name: Earth's fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! Earth-sama~~~!
Please, say something, anything to us!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course... But, 
before that, would you indulge a selfish request of mine?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Will you play them for me... 
Your marcato words of love!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Whereas I... am always the one receiving everyone's support. 
So today, I want to give back to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Royce's fans
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, does that mean—wh-wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The love of my amores fills me. 
A fulfilled heart only gives birth to greater love!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You've given me so much, so here are my feelings— 
take every single bit!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us spread it far and wide— 
An endless, immortal love!

text_block_list.name: Earth & Lois
text_block_list.text:
I want your love. 
I love every one of you♪

text_block_list.name: Fans of the two
text_block_list.text:
'Lady Earth gave me permission to love her...! 
I'll stan her, I'll stan her for life!!' 
'This is Royce-chan's l-o-o-o-ve!'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is the happiness of being loved. 
Grazie, Royce-san...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the pleasure is mine. 
Everyone is thrilled... It's simply perfect.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Loving or being loved, 
either way, it's all about wanting to make the fans happy. 
That was a great hint, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I was just speaking my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's what resonated in our hearts! 
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your music. Grazie!!
choice_data_list: 思ったことを言ったまでだよ
choice_data_list_en: I was just speaking my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'd like to deliver it to you too. 
To be loved, or to love... which do you desire?
choice_data_list: ファンを思う気持ちが届いてよかった
choice_data_list_en: I'm glad your feelings reached the fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The way we are now, we can deliver 
in the exact style you desire.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, look into my eyes and say it. 
My wonderful, lovely amico♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, look into my eyes and say it. 
My wonderful, lovely amica♪

Cornered by the two smiling mischievously, 
I was completely overwhelmed!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, could you help me out again? 
It's very reassuring having you around.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My, I'd like to ask for that as well. 
If only to win over even more fans!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll be glad to help again!
Yeah, I'll be glad to help again!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! What a gentle melodia! 
That spirit of yours is bene, too!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I'll be glad to help again!
Yeah, I'll be glad to help again!

text_block_list.text:
I was genuinely happy to be relied on, 
and my heart felt completely fulfilled!
